serviceDescription.open: Roam runs current structural checks over an agreed change history. The paid service adds a written report, reviewed findings, and a founder walk-through. Historical replay is not proof that an incident would have been prevented; tests are not rerun.
serviceDescription.paused: Roam runs current structural checks over recent commits in a free local sample. Historical replay is not proof that an incident would have been prevented; tests are not rerun.

offers.name: PR Replay — Sample (DIY)
offers.description: Free local sample over HEAD~5..HEAD: a commit range, not necessarily five pull requests. Watermarked; no founder review.

offers.name: PR Replay — Team
offers.description: 30-PR report, 30-min founder walk-through. 50% of fee is banked as a founding-customer credit toward Roam Review; the 60-day redemption window starts when Roam Review reaches general availability, not at report delivery.

offers.name: PR Replay — Deep
offers.description: 90-PR report with per-detector deep-dive, 90-min founder walk-through, written 90-day remediation plan. 50% of fee is banked as a founding-customer credit toward Roam Review; the 60-day redemption window starts when Roam Review reaches general availability, not at report delivery.
